messages:
dan-ux: Quick sync — thinking about a slight IA pivot for the console sidebar. Two options: 1) group by product/workspace (current), 2) group by functional clusters (deployments, models, billing, settings). Also noticed a weird back-button/breadcrumb case when you collapse the sidebar — the breadcrumb seems to reset. Can we decide direction before I mock screens?
clare-design: My vote is functional clusters. Users come in with tasks, not org structure. Also want to propose 'Workspaces' -> 'Projects' copy tweak across the left rail. Small nits: the breadcrumb should never disappear when a panel is open.
sam-frontend: Re: back-button — opened a quick repro. Collapsing triggers a css class and we used location.hash to store collapsed state; unfortunately we call replaceState in that flow which ends up clobbering the last history entry. That explains the breadcrumb/back mismatch.
ollie-eng: Yep saw that. We should avoid push/replace during UI-only transitions. We already have a tiny router helper that treats sidebar toggles as ephemeral; might have accidentally wired it. I'll dig in.
mina-prod: Functional clusters sounds good from product POV — easier to onboard. Two questions: (a) deep links — will old public links still land in the right place after regrouping? (b) anchor semantics for evals and logs — should hash jump to a log line or to the panel?
dan-ux: Good Q. We need a compatibility layer for old links. For anchors: prefer panel-level anchors (#panel=metrics) + section anchors inside the panel (#panel=metrics&anchor=line123). That way the breadcrumb shows panel and we still deep-link into content.
sam-frontend: Proposed router pattern:
```
// deep link example
/app/:org/projects/:projId?panel=metrics&anchor=line123
// on nav: use history.pushState for route changes
// on UI-only changes (collapse/hover): toggle css only, do NOT modify history
```
This keeps the back button consistent and preserves breadcrumb state.
clare-design: Accessibility note: when opening a deep link into a panel, move keyboard focus to the panel heading and announce "Opened: Metrics" via live region. Also ensure skip links respect the new clusters.
ollie-eng: For old links we can keep a mapping table in the route middleware: if incoming path matches /workspace/:id/old-route -> redirect (301) to new /projects/:id?panel=xyz. Low overhead. Also will add a small flag to preserve scroll position when fragment targets exist.
mina-prod: Nice. For copy: prefer 'Projects' (singular nav label should be 'Projects'), and panels: 'Overview', 'Metrics', 'Logs', 'Settings'. Can someone add a one-liner tooltip for 'Projects' explaining it's your team workspaces?
dan-ux: Will update mocks. Clare, can you push the tooltip copy? Also would like a tiny prototype for keyboard nav showing cluster expand/collapse behavior.
clare-design: Tooltip copy draft: "Projects — your team workspaces and deployments." Also changed breadcrumb copy: use > separators and avoid trailing slash. Attached quick figma link: https://figma.com/file/example (proto). :sparkles:
sam-frontend: I'll open a PR tomorrow. Plan: remove history.replace for collapse, implement panel query param routing, route middleware for old->new mapping, and add focus/announce for deep opens. Will tag @ollie-eng for backend redirects test.
navbot: deploy-bot: staging build for sidebar-demo passed (build #4821) :white_check_mark:
ollie-eng: Sounds good. I'll follow up with a small test matrix for deep links (old urls, panel anchors, collapsed state, back-button). If I find any failing cases I'll post repro steps here.
dan-ux: Thanks all — if no objections I'll lock on functional clusters and the router pattern. Will schedule a short review with the FE PR and the figma. :+1:
